description: This script is part of the OpenWrt project and manages diagnostic LED status indicators based on system state and configuration files. It loads configuration data, detects which LED controls to use, and sets LED states accordingly.

methods.name: preinit_match_diag_led
methods.description: Detects and sets the diagnostic LED based on system configuration and board info.

methods.name: match_diag_led
methods.description: Matches the configuration for the diagnostic LED based on parameters.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines which status LED to use based on system configuration.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided system state argument.
